name: hud_duel_timings_follow_the_rules
description: The duel's words name its timings from its rules, not as written numbers (Game.refusal_text, Game.duel_seconds; contract-m7.md §2: uncork_after_t, auto_uncork_t and fizzle_t are tunable). On Undertow's own preset against the caretaker, the match's duel block is set to uncork from 4 s, uncork by itself at 25 s and fizzle at 27 s: the too-early refusal says 4 s, Space too soon after the horn says it on the notice, and the Drift tray's word on my corked bottle says 25 s and 4 s, and on one whose salt is gone 27 s.

steps.assert: Game.refusal_text(8) == 'The cork holds for 3 s after the horn' and Game.duel_seconds('auto_uncork_t') == '24 s' and Game.duel_seconds('fizzle_t') == '25 s'
steps.msg: the preset's numbers: 3 s, 24 s, 25 s

steps.assert: Game.refusal_text(8) == 'The cork holds for 4 s after the horn' and Game.duel_seconds('auto_uncork_t') == '25 s' and Game.duel_seconds('fizzle_t') == '27 s' and Game.duel_seconds('pack_interval_t') == '0.5 s'
steps.msg: the words follow the rules' numbers

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').tip_shown()[1] == 'It uncorks by itself 25 s after the horn of wave 2. From 4 s after it, Space or a click uncorks it sooner.'
steps.msg: my bottle's word: by itself at 25 s, from 4 s by Space or a click

steps.assert: Game.sim.tick < Game.sim.horn_tick + 240 and node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'The cork holds for 4 s after the horn'
steps.msg: Space too soon after the horn: the notice says 4 s

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').tip_shown()[1] == 'Its salt is not on this machine any more, so nothing can uncork it: 27 s after the horn of wave 2 it fizzles, its gold spent.'
steps.msg: a bottle whose salt is gone: it fizzles at 27 s
